applied.summary: Removed the erroneous 'UNSAFE:' prefix that mislabeled a phase/tone (polarity-cancellation) issue as a safety hazard, and replaced the duplicate second polarity item with a distinct mistake (over-aggressive high-passing losing wire crispness). Addresses four converging audio/cognition/language flags.

Technical fix: gate/expander chatter is caused by too-fast release with no hold time or hysteresis while the signal hovers near threshold, not by attack time. Web-verified (Wikipedia Noise gate; Sound On Sound). Attack only sets how fast the gate opens.

Made the closing analogy dynamic ('automatic volume that turns down only when that part gets too loud') so it no longer describes a static per-band level change, avoiding the EQ-vs-compression confusion the entry's own common_mistakes warns against. FK grade 5.9.

Replaced 'dial in the echo' with 'dial in the ambience' so reverb (a wash of reflections) is not conflated with discrete echo/delay, which the glossary treats as a separate concept (Vocal slapback). FK grade 6.1.

Resolved internal contradiction: clarified that Write overwrites the entire pass (hence the erase risk singled out in common_mistakes), while Touch and Latch write absolute values only while the control is actively moved, leaving untouched sections intact.
Fixed malformed idiom: one does not 'strike the point'. Changed 'striking the point where...' to 'finding the point where...'.
Fixed number-agreement slip within one clause (plural 'drums' shifting to singular 'the drum'): 'so the drum seems to fill the room instead of sounding like just the drum itself'. FK grade 6.4.
Fixed garbled phrasing 'Panning sections hard so widely that...' to grammatical 'Panning sections so hard and wide that a chorus collapses to nothing when heard in mono.'
Removed accidental word repetition 'to gain more gain before feedback' -> 'to get more gain before feedback'.

Fixed contradictory phrasing ('the line disappears and jumps out unpredictably') to the intended meaning: 'so the line drops out on some notes and jumps out on others'; also 'hit to hit' -> 'from note to note'.
Fixed garbled 'Cleaning breath and mouth-noise removal' (cannot 'clean a removal') to 'Cleaning up breath and mouth noise so the edited spots do not sound like dead holes'.
